biography.value:
Description

This young adult wingless dragon has rocky scales with two large horns. Brown dragons usually live in caves or underground.

Defense

AC 28, touch 8, flat-footed 28 (+20 natural, -2 size)

hp 232 [320] (16d12+128)

mp 95

Fort +17, Ref +12, Will +18

DR 10/magic;

Immune Earth, Paralysis, Sleep;

Resist Lightning 50%;

SR 24;

Weakness Wind

Offense

Speed 60 ft., burrow 40 ft.

Melee Bite +25 (4d6+16 plus 1d6 earth damage), 2 Claws +25 (2d6+11), Gore +25 (2d6+16), Tail Slap +23 (2d6+16)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite & gore)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (100-ft. line, 10d10 earth damage, Reflex DC 25 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Crush (Small creatures, DC 25, 2d8+16), Earthquake, Eerie Howl, Slow Breath (50-ft. cone, DC 25)

Special Abilities Dragon Force, Triumphant Roar

Spells Known (FC CL 16th, Concentration +22)

At will - detect magic, ignite, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 17) - pass without trace, stone fist

2nd (DC 18) - binding earth, elemental resistance, groundswell, soften earth and stone, stone call, wall climb

3rd (DC 19) - dispel, meld into stone, shifting sand, stone shape

4th (DC 20) - comet, spike stones

5th (DC 21) - stoneskin, transmute mud to rock, transmute rock to mud

Statistics

Str 32, Dex 10, Con 24, Int 11, Wis 22, Cha 16

Base Atk +16; CMB +29; CMD 39 (43 vs. trip)

Feats Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Natural Attack (Bite), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Toughness

Skills Bluff +21, Climb +35, Intimidate +26, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +18, Knowledge (local) +18, Perception +25, Stealth +14; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Stealth

Languages Draconic

SQ Earth glide

description.value: 1/day, a brown dragon releases the dragon soul within, improving itself or an ally by touch. This ability grants the subject an increase to all physical damage, melee and range, by +1 per three caster levels. It also grants the subject an increase to all magical damage and healing by +1 per three caster levels. This ability lasts for a minute. Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).

description.value: Once every 1d2 rounds as a standard action, a brown dragon can cause the ground to erupt around it within a 30-ft.-radius. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).
